instruction: Follow artists of all the songs and albums I have ever liked on Spotify.

steps.code:
passwords = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
spotify_password = None
for account in passwords:
    if account.get("account_name") == "spotify":
        spotify_password = account.get("password")
        break
print(spotify_password)

liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(liked_songs))
print(liked_songs[:2])

liked_albums = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_albums(access_token=spotify_access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not page:
        break
    liked_albums.extend(page)
    if len(page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1
print(len(liked_albums))
print(liked_albums[:2])
